key_insight: B-OPSD boosts self-distillation by training the model ahead to create a stronger future teacher, then distilling that progress back into the original student.
engineering_relevance: For LLM training pipelines, this suggests a practical way to recycle optimization progress into denser and more reliable supervision without changing the base architecture.
method: Temporarily optimize the policy forward to form a future self-teacher.
Restore the student to its original state before continuing training.
Use the future teacher to supervise the restarted student on on-policy trajectories with privileged information.
evidence_signal: On mathematical reasoning tasks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, the method consistently improved over standard OPSD, including rollout-privileged gains from 27.50 to 41.30 and from 48.80 to 64.44.
watch_item: The approach adds an extra train-then-restore stage, so stability, compute cost, and how far to train the future teacher may affect practical deployment.
paper_title: Train Ahead, Distill Back: Bootstrapping On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models
